confidence_notes: Bangkok-specific Numbeo food prices nearest the July window were dated June 10, 2026. Cocktail and wine-glass prices are less certain: I estimated them from the local beer price relationship; Nomadlio's October listing of an $11 restaurant cocktail is a supporting check. BudgetYourTrip lists hostel averages of $17 for a dorm bed and $25 for a private room before taxes and fees, so those anchors allow for added fees. KAYAK showed a $37 average for three-star hotels; the very basic room estimate is less certain and uses a Bangkok budget-accommodation price range rather than a direct one-star average.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed; the estimates use Bangkok-specific prices and accommodation data.
